name: logs
sampleSql:
SELECT ts, id, service, severity, body, trace_id, span_id, source
FROM {{logs}}
WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 500

name: metric
sampleSql:
SELECT ts, name, value, labels, kind
FROM {{metrics}}
WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end AND ((((name = $cf0) AND (json_extract_string(CASE WHEN json_valid(labels) THEN labels ELSE NULL END, $jp1) = $p2))))
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 500

name: delta
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT json_extract_string(CASE WHEN json_valid(labels) THEN labels ELSE NULL END, $jp1) AS "labels[""host,name""]", sum(TRY_CAST("value" AS DOUBLE)) AS value
FROM (SELECT * EXCLUDE (value, previous_value), CASE WHEN previous_value IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE value - previous_value END AS value FROM (SELECT *, lag(value) OVER (PARTITION BY name, labels ORDER BY ts) AS previous_value FROM {{metrics}} WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end AND (((name = $cf0)))))
WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end
GROUP BY "labels[""host,name""]"
) ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10000

name: trace
sampleSql:
SELECT ts, service, name, duration_us, status, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, attributes, kind, resource, events
FROM {{traces}}
WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 500

name: session
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT "domain", count(*) AS value
FROM (SELECT project_key, session_id, min(ts) AS ts, arg_max(user_agent, ts) AS user_agent, arg_max(domain, ts) AS domain FROM {{sessions}} WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY project_key, session_id)
WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end
GROUP BY "domain"
) ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10000
